sketch:
Four written deductions, one open claim and one route.
(1) fpbs-clopen-certificate-cost-transfer. A clopen certificate is a finite list of clopen partial maps plus repair edges s|N_s on the sets with no short path of product s. For every invariant measure on L^G, cost is at most the certificate value. For essentially free measures cost equals the infimum of certificate values. A certificate's value moves by at most (M+|S|) times the window total-variation distance when the measure changes.
(2) fpbs-finite-alphabet-models-suffice-for-fixed-price. Pass to ergodic components, take the product with a Bernoulli shift, truncate a near-optimal graphing, then descend to the factor generated by the finite pieces and the Bernoulli coordinate. That factor is a free ergodic finite-alphabet shift measure with cost below C(a)+eps. So fixed price for a fg group holds iff C(nu) >= C(b) for all such nu.
(3) fpbs-fixed-price-iff-cost-lsc-at-bernoulli. Let nu_0 be free ergodic on K^G. Its Rokhlin entropy is at most log|K| < log(|K|+1). Seward Corollary 6.1 then gives isomorphic shift models nu_n -> lambda^G on (|K|+1)^G. LSC at lambda^G gives C(b) <= C(nu_0). Abert-Weiss with monotone cost makes USC automatic. A counterexample reduces to one cheap finite-alphabet action with a race inequality: cheap certificates of the models need (M+|S|)TV_W >= eta/2.
(4) fpbs-window-local-cost-lower-bounds-fail-at-bernoulli (calibration kill). Take a residually finite G with an infinite amenable quotient A. Pull back the Bernoulli shift of H=(q,p)(G) inside Q x A, with q finite and injective on B_R. The resulting nu_R is exactly iid and free on B_R, ergodic, aperiodic, with cost 1, and nu_R -> lambda^G. So cost jumps by >= beta_1^(2)(G) there; for F_r the jump is >= r-1. No window-local hypothesis forces Bernoulli cost.
Open: fpbs-cost-lsc-at-bernoulli-shift-measures, labelled as a restatement. Route fpbs-bernoulli-lower-bound-from-cost-lsc targets fpbs-free-action-cost-at-least-bernoulli-cost. An Attempts bullet was added to the goal.
